---
name: Entry correction
about: Report a wrong, unsupported or mis-cited claim in a creature entry
title: "Correction: <entry id>"
labels: correction
---

**Entry id**
<!-- The entry's id, e.g. `leshy` (the file name under data/entries/ without .json). -->

**Clause**
<!-- Quote the clause exactly as it appears in the entry. -->

> 

**Cite tag**
<!-- The citation tag attached to that clause, e.g. `afanasyev1868:p.326`. -->

**Correction**
<!-- What the clause should say instead, or why it should be removed. -->

**Source for the correction**
<!-- Author, title, edition and page. A public-domain source with an archive.org or
Wikisource link is easiest to check. -->
